metadata.question: Does vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan from February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Taklamakan Desert near Hotan (coordinates approximately 37.1°N, 79.9°E) - Dates: February 23, 2020 and April 29, 2020 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution) or Landsat 8 (30m) for NDVI analysis - Need to compare vegetation cover between two specific dates 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, need to mask clouds to get accurate vegetation readings - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 or pixel_qa for Landsat - Question is about vegetation increase, not cloud presence 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: NDVI values in range [-1, 1], even if close to 0 (desert) - C1: No images found for either date - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: NDVI calculation returns None/NaN or out of valid range - A: NDVI increases from Feb to Apr - B: NDVI stays same or decreases ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location - Hotan area in Taklamakan Desert const hotan = ee.Geometry.Point([79.9, 37.1]); const roi = hotan.buffer(50000); // 50km radius // 2. Define dates const date1Start = '2020-02-20'; const date1End = '2020-02-26'; const date2Start = '2020-04-26'; const date2End = '2020-05-02'; // 3. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 5. Acquire February data let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2020 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End); const size1_l8 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2020 Landsat Images: ${size1_l8}`); if (size1_l8 === 0) { console.log('No data for February 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 6. Acquire April data let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2020 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End); const size2_l8 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2020 Landsat Images: ${size2_l8}`); if (size2_l8 === 0) { console.log('No data for April 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 7. Create median composites const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // 8. Check pixel counts const count1 = img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`February valid pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`April valid pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi1 = img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2 = img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`February NDVI: ${ndvi1}`); console.log(`April NDVI: ${ndvi2}`); // 10. Validation and final answer if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2)) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1) { console.log('NDVI out of valid range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const change = ndvi2 - ndvi1; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${change.toFixed(4)}`); if (change > 0) { console.log('Vegetation cover increased.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation cover did not increase.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
